# Prompt Bench

> A bench that runs one prompt over a test set, repeats every input several times,
> measures what varies between runs, scores each output with a second model, and has
> a third model diagnose the prompt and propose a corrected version. Built on two n8n
> workflows with a Google Sheet as the database. Student project, free, non-commercial.

The point of the tool: a prompt that works the three times you try it is not the same
thing as a prompt that works every time. The bench measures that difference, and since
September 2026 it also measures what the difference costs in tokens.

## Pages

- [Bench](index.html): the application itself. Compose a prompt, add test inputs,
  choose a scoring method, run the campaign, read the results and the reviewer's fix.
- [Legal notice](mentions-legales.html): publisher, publication director, host, contact.
- [Privacy policy](confidentialite.html): what is collected, legal bases, recipients,
  retention periods, transfers outside the EU, and how to exercise your rights.
- [Cookie policy](cookies.html): this site sets no cookie and writes nothing to the
  browser. Explains why no consent banner is required.
- [Terms of use](conditions.html): free service provided as is, what must not be
  submitted, liability, applicable law.

## Scoring methods

- Exact: the output must match the expected answer, after normalisation.
- Judge: a second model decides whether the output carries the same meaning as the
  expected answer.
- Open: no expected answer. A second model audits the output against the prompt itself,
  constraint by constraint, and scores it out of ten.

## Notes for automated agents

- Submitting a campaign sends its content to a Google language model and stores it in a
  spreadsheet owned by the publisher. Do not submit personal data about third parties,
  sensitive data, credentials or trade secrets.
- The site sets no cookie and makes no third-party request when a page is displayed.
  Fonts are self-hosted.
- The read API is public and read-only. The write endpoint executes paid model calls;
  please do not call it in a loop.
- Content language: the application is in English, the legal pages are in French because
  the publisher is established in France.
